items.exampleEn: A pair of white swans swam slowly across the lake.
items.exampleZh: 一對白天鵝在湖面上緩緩前進。

items.exampleEn: We had lunch next to a small cascade in the forest.
items.exampleZh: 我們在森林裡一道小瀑布旁吃午餐。

items.exampleEn: A wasp landed on the jam at our picnic.
items.exampleZh: 野餐時，一隻黃蜂停在果醬上。

items.exampleEn: The leopard rested on a high branch during the hot afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 炎熱的午後，那隻豹在高高的樹枝上休息。

items.exampleEn: The ram on the hill has large, round horns.
items.exampleZh: 山坡上那隻公羊有一對又大又圓的角。

items.exampleEn: Over thousands of years, the river cut a deep gorge through the mountains.
items.exampleZh: 經過數千年，這條河在山間切出一道深深的峽谷。

items.exampleEn: The old church in the village was built of red sandstone.
items.exampleZh: 村裡那座老教堂是用紅色砂岩蓋的。

items.exampleEn: She planted yellow tulips along the garden path.
items.exampleZh: 她沿著花園小徑種了黃色的鬱金香。

items.sentenceEn: We watched a wasp flying in and out of a hole in the wall.
items.sentenceZh: 我們看著一隻黃蜂在牆上的一個洞飛進飛出。

items.audioEn: The tulips in the park open in March, but the best time to visit is early April.
items.audioZh: 公園裡的鬱金香三月開花，但最適合去的時間是四月初。
items.questionZh: 說話者認為什麼時候去公園最好？

items.sentenceEn: The leopard's spots help it hide in the long grass.
items.sentenceZh: 豹身上的斑點幫助牠躲在長草裡。

items.sentenceEn: The walls of the gorge are made of soft sandstone.
items.sentenceZh: 這道峽谷的石壁是由鬆軟的砂岩構成的。

items.stemEn: In the story, the ugly little bird grows up to become a beautiful ____.
items.stemZh: 故事裡，那隻醜醜的小鳥長大後變成一隻美麗的天鵝。

items.stemEn: After the heavy rain, water poured over the cliff in a white ____.
items.stemZh: 大雨過後，水從懸崖上傾瀉而下，形成一道白色的小瀑布。

items.passageEn: Last spring, my family spent a weekend at a national park in the south. On the first day, we hiked along a narrow gorge. Its red sandstone walls rose high above us, and in some places a cascade fell from the top. Our guide said that leopards once lived in these hills, but nobody has seen one for fifty years. On the second day, we stopped at a roadside stand to buy tulips. Next to it, an old ram kept pushing a wooden gate with its head, and the owner laughed and said it did that every day.
items.passageZh: 去年春天，我們一家人在南部的一座國家公園度過一個週末。第一天，我們沿著一道狹窄的峽谷健行。紅色砂岩的石壁高高聳立在我們上方，有些地方還有小瀑布從頂端落下。導遊說這片山區以前有豹，但五十年來沒有人再看過。第二天，我們在路邊的花攤停下來買鬱金香。花攤旁有一隻老公羊一直用頭推一道木頭柵門，老闆笑著說牠每天都這樣。

questions.questionZh: 第一天他們在哪裡健行？

referenceEn: The Netherlands is famous for its tulips.
The Netherlands is well known for tulips.
rubricZh: 要用 tulip 的複數（例如 tulips）
「以…聞名」可寫，例如 be famous for、be known for 等

items.promptZh: 我爸爸小心地把那隻黃蜂趕出窗外。
referenceEn: My father carefully chased the wasp out of the window.
My dad carefully chased the wasp out the window.
rubricZh: wasp 表示「黃蜂」（例如 the wasp 等）
「趕出窗外」可寫，例如 chased … out of the window、chased … out the window 等
carefully 位置不扣分；時態可用過去式或現在完成式
